title: Inactive SOI and FAMILY compatibility interface
acceptance_conditions: The generic SOI topology/method/result contract, schemas and maturity registry are complete.
FAMILY alone is EXECUTABLE_INACTIVE through an exact preserved-SFC FamilyCatalog adapter.
HIERARCHY, OVERLAP, GRAPH, CONTINUUM and COMPOSITION remain INTERFACE_ONLY and fail closed without placeholder results.
Source programme, catalog, configuration, family, assignment and logical hashes remain exact and source bytes immutable.

NO_STABLE_FAMILY is scoped to FAMILY and cannot imply no organisation; OrganisationEvidence remains WP7-owned.
Exact-head repository/parity/FINAL_HEAD/stable-main assurance passes with no blocking reviews/issues.
warnings: PR #728 is preserved as stale-main evidence; current candidate is rebuilt from lawful main after GRT2-WP0.

non_reserved_rationale: The packet adds deterministic inactive contracts, schemas, registries, preserved-source adapter, fixtures and tests only. It does not select or activate a topology, method, family, representation or semantic interpretation and consumes no Validation, provider, publication, risk or execution authority.
next_after_pass: Squash-merge bounded WP6, materialise merge receipt and G6-completed programme state, then leave ESLI-WP7 READY without starting it.
